1.text:
s = 10 + 4t

The equation gives the speed s, in miles per hour, of a certain car t seconds after it began to accelerate. What is the speed, in miles per hour, of the car 5 seconds after it began to accelerate?

2.text: What is the y-intercept of the graph shown?
2.showWork: The y-intercept is where the graph crosses the y-axis (x = 0). The curve meets the y-axis at y = 9, so the point is (0, 9). The horizontal asymptote y = 6 is a distractor.

3.text: The width of a rectangle is 5 centimeters. The length of the rectangle is 30 centimeters longer than the width. What is the area, in square centimeters, of this rectangle?
3.showWork: Length = 5 + 30 = 35 cm. Area = length × width = 35(5) = 175 square centimeters.

4.text: If 6 + x = 3, what is the value of 42 + 7x?

5.text: In the right triangle shown, what is the value of x?
5.showWork: The legs are 18 and 40, and x is the hypotenuse. Pythagorean theorem: x^2 = 18^2 + 40^2 = 324 + 1,600 = 1,924, so x = √1,924.

6.text: If x/y = 87 and cx/(3y) = 87, what is the value of c?
6.showWork: Rewrite the second equation as (c/3)(x/y) = 87. Substitute x/y = 87 to get (c/3)(87) = 87, so c/3 = 1 and c = 3.

7.text: In right triangle RST, the sum of the measures of angle R and angle S is 90 degrees. The value of sin(R) is 4√2/9. What is the value of cos(S)?
7.showWork: Angles R and S are complementary, and the sine of an angle equals the cosine of its complement. So cos(S) = sin(R) = 4√2/9.

8.text: Antwon's hair will grow at a constant rate from a length of 3 inches to a length of 5 inches. The equation 0.3t + 3 = 5 describes this situation, where t is the number of months it will take for Antwon's hair to reach a length of 5 inches. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 0.3 in this context?

choices.A: The time, in months, it will take Antwon's hair to grow 1 inch
choices.B: The length, in inches, Antwon's hair will grow each month
choices.C: The time, in months, it will take Antwon's hair to reach a length of 5 inches
choices.D: The length, in inches, Antwon's hair will grow in 5 months

8.showWork: In 0.3t + 3 = 5, t is time in months and 3 and 5 are lengths in inches, so 0.3 is the constant growth rate in inches per month: the length Antwon's hair will grow each month.

9.text:
2x(x − 3)(x + 5) = 0

What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
9.showWork: A product is 0 when a factor is 0, so x = 0, x = 3, or x = −5. Of the choices, only 0 is a solution.

10.text: In the linear function f, f(0) = 7 and f(2) = 7. Which equation defines f?
10.showWork: A linear function with f(0) = f(2) = 7 has slope 0, so it is the constant function f(x) = 7.

11.text: The product of a positive number x and the number that is 1 less than x is equal to 272. What is the value of x?
11.showWork: x(x − 1) = 272 → x^2 − x − 272 = 0 → (x − 17)(x + 16) = 0, so x = 17 or x = −16. The positive value is 17.

12.text:
4x^2 − x = 18

What is the positive solution to the given equation?
12.showWork: 4x^2 − x − 18 = 0. Quadratic formula: x = (1 ± √(1 + 288))/8 = (1 ± 17)/8. The solutions are 18/8 = 2.25 and −16/8 = −2. The positive solution is 2.25.

13.text: A sample of a certain isotope takes 29 years to decay to half its original mass. The function s(t) = 184(0.5)^(t/29) gives the approximate mass of this isotope, in grams, that remains t years after a 184-gram sample starts to decay. Which statement is the best interpretation of s(58) = 46 in this context?

choices.A: Approximately 46 grams of the sample remains 58 years after the sample starts to decay.
choices.B: The mass of the sample has decreased by approximately 46 grams 58 years after the sample starts to decay.
choices.C: The mass of the sample has decreased by approximately 58 grams 46 years after the sample starts to decay.
choices.D: Approximately 58 grams of the sample remains 46 years after the sample starts to decay.

13.showWork: s(t) is remaining mass after t years, so s(58) = 46 means 46 grams remain after 58 years. Check: 184(0.5)^(58/29) = 184(0.5)^2 = 46.

14.text: Tanya drove on the highway and on local roads to complete a trip of 290 miles. The drive took 5 hours. She drove an average speed of 65 miles per hour (mph) on the highway and an average speed of 30 mph on local roads. If x is the time, in hours, Tanya drove on the highway and y is the time, in hours, she drove on local roads, which system of equations represents this situation?
14.showWork: Distance: 65x + 30y = 290. Time: x + y = 5. Swapping the 65/30 pairing or swapping the totals 290 and 5 gives the other choices.

15.text:
y < −2x + 14

Which point (x, y) is a solution to the given inequality in the xy-plane?
15.showWork: Test each point in y < −2x + 14. A: 15 < 14 false. B: 17 < 16 false. C: 0 < 4 + 14 = 18 true. D: −1 < −16 + 14 = −2 false. Only (−2, 0) works.

16.text:
(x − 35)^2 = 1

What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
16.showWork: x − 35 = ±1, so x = 36 or x = 34. The sum is 36 + 34 = 70. (Equivalently, expanding gives x^2 − 70x + 1,224 = 0, whose solutions sum to 70.)

17.text: A dance studio charges an introductory fee for the first 3 lessons and then charges a fixed fee for each additional lesson. One student took 6 lessons and was charged $150. Another student took 17 lessons and was charged $480. Which function f gives the total charge, in dollars, for any student who took x lessons, where x > 3?
17.showWork: For x > 3 the charge is linear. Slope = (480 − 150)/(17 − 6) = 330/11 = 30 dollars per additional lesson. Using (6, 150): 150 = 30(6) + b → b = −30. So f(x) = 30x − 30.

18.text: How many <u>centimeters</u> are equivalent to 35 meters? (1 meter = 100 centimeters)

19.text: A researcher observes a sample of a nuclide. An exponential model estimates that the mass, in grams, of the sample decreases by 23% every 11.69 minutes. Which of the following equations could represent this model, where M is the estimated mass, in grams, of the sample t minutes after the researcher began observing the sample?
19.showWork: Decreasing by 23% leaves 77% of the mass, so the growth factor is 0.77, ruling out C and D. That factor applies once per 11.69-minute period, so the exponent must count periods: t/11.69. This gives M = 100(0.77)^(t/11.69).

20.text:
Data set A: 8, 11, 12, 15, 21, 27
Data set B: 9, 12, 13, 16, 22, h

Data sets A and B each consist of 6 values as shown, where h is a constant. If the standard deviation of data set A is greater than the standard deviation of data set B, which of the following could be the value of h?

I. 23
II. 28
III. 29
20.showWork: The first five values of B are each 1 more than the first five values of A. If h = 28, then B is A shifted by 1 and the standard deviations are equal. For SD(A) > SD(B), h must pull B inward relative to that shift, so h = 23 works and h = 29 (farther out) makes SD(B) larger. Only I.

21.text: In triangle RST, the measure of angle R is 50°, the measure of angle S is x°, and the measure of angle T is (4x − 5)°. Point L lies on RS, point K lies on ST, and LK is parallel to RT. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle SKL? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
21.showWork: Angle sum in triangle RST: 50 + x + (4x − 5) = 180 → 5x + 45 = 180 → x = 27. Then angle T = 4(27) − 5 = 103°. LK ∥ RT with transversal ST, so angle SKL corresponds to angle T. Therefore angle SKL = 103.
